interventions_body_scan_arms_text: Feel your fingers, palms, and arms. Let them soften.
interventions_body_scan_belly_text: Feel your belly rise and fall. Notice where your back touches the surface.
interventions_body_scan_chest_text: Notice your breath in your chest. Let it find its own rhythm.
interventions_body_scan_face_text: Let your shoulders drop. Unclench your jaw. Soften the space between your eyebrows.
interventions_body_scan_feet_text: Notice your feet. Warmth, coolness, pressure. Only notice, no need to change anything.
interventions_body_scan_lead: Move your attention slowly through your body, from feet to face. About eight minutes. Good before bed.
interventions_body_scan_legs_text: Move up through your calves and thighs. Let them feel heavy.
interventions_body_scan_science: Paying calm attention to your body lowers muscle tension and can make it easier to fall asleep.
interventions_body_scan_settle_text: Let your eyes close or rest on one spot. Notice the weight of your body.
interventions_body_scan_what_1: Sit or lie down somewhere comfortable
interventions_body_scan_what_2: Each part gets about a minute, and the screen moves on by itself
interventions_body_scan_what_3: Pause any time. There is nothing to get right
interventions_body_scan_whole_text: Feel your whole body at once, breathing. Rest here for a moment.
interventions_done_body: You took a moment for yourself. How do you feel compared to before?
interventions_offer_anxiety: Want a moment to settle? Pick one, if you like.
interventions_prompt_hint: Take your time. Nothing is saved.
interventions_slow_breath_lead: Breathe in for 4 seconds and out for 6. Six rounds, about one minute.
interventions_slow_breath_science: A longer exhale activates the part of your nervous system that slows your heart rate.
interventions_slow_breath_what_1: Sit or stand however feels comfortable
interventions_slow_breath_what_2: Follow the circle: in as it grows, out as it shrinks
interventions_slow_breath_what_3: If your mind drifts, come back to the next breath
interventions_worry_check_control_body: Find one part, however small. Some things are out of your hands, and that is okay.
interventions_worry_check_control_exampl: You can’t control how others react. You can prepare two key points.
interventions_worry_check_lead: Look at one worry from a few angles. No writing, only thinking. About four minutes.
interventions_worry_check_likely_body: Not how bad it would be. How likely. Think about what usually happens in situations like this.
interventions_worry_check_likely_example: Has it gone badly before? How often?
interventions_worry_check_name_body: Say it to yourself in one sentence. Be specific.
interventions_worry_check_name_example: “I’m worried that the meeting tomorrow goes badly.”
interventions_worry_check_science: Naming a worry and sorting it into “can control” and “can’t control” makes it feel smaller and easier to handle.
interventions_worry_check_step_body: Something you can do in the next 24 hours. Or decide to let this worry rest until then.
interventions_worry_check_what_1: Name the worry in one sentence
interventions_worry_check_what_2: Check how likely it really is
interventions_worry_check_what_3: Find the part you can control

privacy_content:
Pixy gives you the ability to reflect on your day and store potentially sensitive information. I want to be as transparent as possible on the usage of your data. So allow me to explain how the data is used and why your data is safe.

### We don’t have access to your tracked information

Your data is saved locally on your device. It is never shared with anyone except if you choose to export it or use the webhook functionality.

### Error Logs

**To find issues and maintain stability, we look at reported error logs.**

We collect error logs with the service provider Sentry. It gives us the possibility to see the time, the screen opened and the type of the device. We use this to reproduce the error and to provide a fix.

### Behavioral Data

When you open a screen or change a setting, this will be sent to one of our analytics tools. This data is sent anonymized. None of your personal data is sent. For example, if Laura Birmingham tracks her mood. We only see that user 101029 did this action.

We use Posthog Cloud to collect and visualize data. It helps us to better understand trends and to find areas for improvement.


---------

If you have any questions or concerns, drop me a line at [care@pixy.day](mailto:care@pixy.day).

**I use this app by myself and I would never want to share personal data with any developer.**
privacy_people_content:
### People

To import people from your contacts, Pixy lists the names in your address book on your device. Pixy saves only the contacts you pick: their name and photo. Both stay on your device and are part of your export file. Pixy never sends names or photos to us.

statistics_trends_description: Your trends from the last two weeks
step_track_description: Shows this step when you check in.
storage_load_error_advice: Close and reopen the app. If this keeps happening, export your data and contact support at care@pixy.day.
storage_load_error_body: Your data is still stored on this device. Nothing was deleted.
storage_load_error_title: Your entries could not be loaded
support_pixy_body: Pixy is free to use and supported by optional contributions. If it has been useful to you, you may support its continued development.
support_pixy_error_fix: Try again. Pixy remains fully usable.
tag_categories_info: Drag categories to change their order in your check-in. Deleting a category moves its tags to {{general}}.
tag_categories_reached_max: You reached the maximum of {{max_count}} categories. Delete a category to add a new one.
tag_category_delete_confirm_message: Its tags move to {{general}}. Your entries keep their tags.
tag_category_general_info: {{general}} can’t be deleted. Tags without a category go here.
tags_feedback_body: Tags are a new way to categorize your data. You can add up to 30 unique tags to your entries. They are planned to be used in statistics in the future. Please send me your feedback below. I read every single message from you.
tags_feedback_question: How do you like the new tags feature?
tags_reached_max: You reached the maximum of {{max_count}} tags. Please delete some tags to add new ones.
tags_reached_max_archived: You reached the maximum of {{max_count}} tags. Archived tags count too. Delete an archived tag to free a slot.
title: Title
voice_failed_body: Something went wrong while listening. Try again.
voice_failed_language: Speech recognition for your language is not on this device. Download it in Settings > General > Keyboard > Dictation Languages, then try again.
voice_failed_siri: On this iOS version, voice mode needs Siri. Turn on Siri in Settings, or update to iOS 26.
voice_feedback_title: How was checking in by voice?
voice_hint: Talk about your day: who you connected with, what you did, how you feel.
voice_permission_body: Pixy needs microphone and speech recognition access to write your check-in. Speech is processed on your device. Audio is never saved.
widget_guide_step_1_body: Press an empty area on your Home Screen until the apps start to jiggle.
widget_guide_step_2_body: Both sit in the top-left corner. On older iOS versions, tap the + button instead.
widget_guide_step_3_body: Search for Pixy, choose 4 weeks, Month, or Year, then tap Add Widget.
year_in_pixels_description: My average mood of each day in {{date}}
